headline: DARING AERONAUT CROSSES THE IRISH SEA IN BALLOON, FIRST EVER SUCH FEAT
dispatch: Windham William Sadler completed the first successful aerial crossing of the Irish Sea by balloon on Tuesday, departing from the English coast and landing safely on the Irish shore after a perilous flight over open water. The crossing, previously considered too dangerous for any balloonist to attempt, was accomplished without catastrophe despite fierce winds above the waves. Sadler thus followed his late father James in securing an extraordinary place among the boldest aerial voyagers of the age.
answer: Windham Sadler crosses the Irish Sea by balloon, 1817
